fixed_before: Any synthetic or Clotho training in this plan, and any generation or evaluation of the fold 2 confirmation half.
history: v1 (phase2/b2-mixtures-v1) failed its full-audio accuracy gate because of a yes bias. The v1 development mixtures were then used to choose this plan, so they are design data. Claims rest on the confirmation half.
stimuli: Unchanged from phase2/b2-mixtures-v1/plan.json (same generator, same train and development manifests). Confirmation mixtures use the same rules on the fold 2 confirmation half with generation_seed 20261125, 100 recordings per N.
primary_metric: Within-recording ranking: for each recording, 1 if the question about the present category gets a higher yes-minus-no score than the question about the absent category, else 0. Average the two option orders' scores first, then the seeds, per recording. Bootstrap over recordings, seed 17, 10000 replicates.

full_audio_gate.rule: Full-audio within-recording ranking at least 0.80 in each option order.
full_audio_gate.note: 0.80 is the same number as the v1 accuracy gate. N=6 fails and is reported as secondary only.

training.parents: runs/guidance/k{K}-s{seed}-parent (audio-only, trained on Clotho in B1), K in 1, 4, 16, seeds 17, 18, 19.
training.data: Synthetic train split (fold 1), all N, 3600 questions.
training.optimizer: Same as bottleneck.py: AdamW lr 1e-3, batch 1, gradient clipping 1.0, gate lr 1e-2 without weight decay, decoder prompt 'A. yes / B. no'.

arms.audio: audio-only control, same warm start and steps
arms.gatedc: B1 gated + centered: unit-normalized projection of the centered, layer-normed mean stem embedding, times tanh(gate), added to every query
arms.route: slot-level routing: each learned query attends over the stem's layer-normed token embeddings (own 64-d key and value projections); each slot's offset is unit-normalized and scaled by tanh(gate). Different slots can receive different offsets.

training.start_check: With the gate at zero, guided and audio-only logits must be identical on every development question; the gate must receive a nonzero gradient.

evaluation.conditions: correct stem, wrong stem (the other question about the same recording), generic stem 'What can be heard in this recording?', no question; both option orders
evaluation.pressure_cells: A (K, N) cell with N in {1, 2, 4} is a pressure cell if the trained audio-only control's development ranking (mean of seeds) is at least 5 points below full audio. Chosen from the audio-only control only, before looking at guided arms.
evaluation.primary_contrasts: For each guided arm (gatedc, route), averaged over pressure cells: (1) correct stem minus audio-only control, (2) correct stem minus wrong stem, on the same trained model.
evaluation.success: Both contrasts at least +5 points with the lower bound of the 97.5% interval (two arms) above zero, on the confirmation half.
evaluation.development_role: Development results decide whether to run the confirmation and which arm leads. If no arm reaches +5 on both contrasts on development, the confirmation still runs for the leading arm so the null is measured on fresh recordings.

clotho.data: All unanimous (3 of 3 annotators) yes/no questions on the 384 official-train recordings present locally (1125 questions); disjoint from fresh_val, the pilot validation recordings and track A's natural-capacity pairs.
clotho.grid: Same three arms, K in 1, 4, 16, seeds 17-19, warm start from the same Clotho parents, 2250 steps (two epochs).
clotho.evaluation: fresh_val 340 questions with the four stem conditions and the B1 contrasts; reported as development evidence only. The official test stays reserved.
